name: Courtside Deck

appearance.direction: Preserved approved C1 v2 direction; no redraw.
appearance.signature: Synthetic court video above rally-edge editing and review decisions.
appearance.question: Are this rally's bounds, inclusion and serving side correct?

behavior.header: Start earlier/later by exactly 1000 ms, centered rally number, End earlier/later by exactly 1000 ms. Four 44 by 44 pixel targets. Clamp to source limits and minimum 500 ms rally duration.
behavior.bounds: Direct continuous pointer dragging and 100 ms arrow-key edits, or 1000 ms with Shift, remain available. Bounds screen retains its 100 ms steppers.
behavior.browsing: Independently scroll all 36 chronological cards by wheel, touch or keyboard. Scrolling updates the list center marker without changing selection, source position or screen.
behavior.listMarker: Outlined diamond on the right of the source rail; filled playback dot on the left. List identity stays visible above the list. The closest card center to the actual list client viewport center determines the rally; its exact midpoint determines source position.
behavior.following: Manual input suspends playback following until an explicit source seek or card selection. Scroll events only update list state and marker; they never seek. Source seeking stays in Browse and centers the nearest rally. Collapse/reopen preserves list position and following state.
behavior.missing: A source gap is highlighted without selecting a card. Explicit Add missing rally opens Editor at the exact source position. Adding and returning preserve that position.
behavior.progress: Screen-top needs-review/checked progress, decision completion and Reset retained.

packaging.fixtureAndFrame: Approved v2 synthetic fixture and embedded SVG frame retained. The 36 rally records are unchanged.
packaging.fontLicense: FONT-LICENSES.txt, copied unchanged from approved input.
packaging.fontRepair: Parent restored the original approved C1 regular, medium and semibold fonts as unhinted WOFF2 subsets. All three decode successfully in the T3 browser; original glyph outlines, family and copyright/license metadata are retained. Prototype JavaScript is byte-identical to the received agent artifact.

functionalCoverage: all four 1000 ms actions and all four constraints
unchanged playhead during wheel and touch browsing
variable source gaps and card heights

tasteLint.reason: Zero-padding is used for clocks, not decorative index labels.

tasteInspect.reason: The wide desktop margin is intentional for the requested 390 px portrait prototype.

validation.visualReview: All final inspector captures and five-mode contact sheets at each requested width inspected. Controls fit without overflow or clipping.

parentChecks.scope: Final standalone font loading, header layouts and exact 1s actions, trusted independent wheel scrolling and viewport-center marker geometry.

validation.agentChecksArtifactStage: Received agent prototype before parent font repair; JavaScript remained byte-identical.

requiredReads: approved C1 v2 baseline and font license
isolationReceipt.writes: Only this v3 directory; evidence and scripts are ignored under .process/.

limitations: Playback, video frame, scores and decisions remain a local synthetic simulation, as in v2.
Touch validation uses Chromium's trusted emulated touch input, not physical hardware. Actual gestures used the assigned Taste CDP helper after the supplied repeated T3 drag timeouts.
